name: Green Day

whyMatters.en: East Bay pop-punk trio formed in 1987. Dookie (1994) put Basket Case power-chord hooks on MTV beside grunge; American Idiot (2004) later brought concept-album punk to stadium scale.
whyMatters.zh: 东湾 pop-punk 三人组，1987 年成立。《Dookie》（1994）把《Basket Case》的 power-chord 钩子送上 MTV，与 grunge 并列；《American Idiot》（2004）后把概念专集朋克带到体育场体量。

lyricQuotes: Do you have the time / To listen to me whine
Don't want to be an American idiot

shortBio.en: Berkeley pop-punk three, 1987–. Dookie’s Basket Case is the mass hit; American Idiot is the concept stadium return.
shortBio.zh: 伯克利 pop-punk 三人，1987 年至今。《Dookie》的《Basket Case》是大众热单；《American Idiot》是概念体育场回归。

body.en:
Green Day formed in Berkeley/Rodeo in 1987 as Sweet Children. Tré Cool replaced John Kiffmeyer (Al Sobrante) in 1990. Dookie (1994, Rob Cavallo) is the citation LP: Longview bass intro, Basket Case power-chord chorus, When I Come Around—East Bay punk onto MTV/alt radio beside Nirvana.

American Idiot (2004) is the second mass hinge: political concept, Jesus of Suburbia suite, stadium punk production. 21st Century Breakdown adds Last Night on Earth. Writing stays three-chord clarity and Armstrong melody.
body.zh:
Green Day 于 1987 年在伯克利/Rodeo 成立（原名 Sweet Children）。Tré Cool 于 1990 年接替 John Kiffmeyer（Al Sobrante）。《Dookie》（1994，Rob Cavallo）是引用 LP：《Longview》贝斯 intro、《Basket Case》power-chord 副歌、《When I Come Around》——东湾朋克进入 MTV/alt 电台，与 Nirvana 并列。

《American Idiot》（2004）是第二次大众铰链：政治概念、《Jesus of Suburbia》组曲、体育场朋克制作。《21st Century Breakdown》加入《Last Night on Earth》。写法保持三和弦清晰与 Armstrong 旋律。

note.en: Dookie power-chord chorus; 1994 pop-punk mass breakthrough.
note.zh: 《Dookie》power-chord 副歌；1994 pop-punk 大众突破。

note.en: Concept-album title track; political hook at stadium punk scale.
note.zh: 概念专集标题曲；体育场朋克体量的政治钩子。

note.en: From 21st Century Breakdown; Armstrong melody over a soft dynamic.
note.zh: 出自《21st Century Breakdown》；Armstrong 旋律压在较软动态上。

title.en: East Bay punk on mass alt radio
title.zh: 东湾朋克上大众 alt 电台

body.en:
Green Day keep Ramones-length songs and power-chord grids, then add Armstrong’s melodic chorus for 1994 radio.

Basket Case is the core Dookie single. American Idiot later returns the same trio as concept stadium punk.

Form is verse-chorus punk clarity, not grunge soft-loud.
body.zh:
Green Day 保持 Ramones 曲长与 power-chord 网格，再加 Armstrong 旋律副歌打 1994 电台。

《Basket Case》是《Dookie》的核心单曲。《American Idiot》后来以同一三人组做概念体育场朋克。

曲式是主副歌朋克清晰，而非 grunge soft-loud。

title.zh: Armstrong / Dirnt / Tré Cool 三人

body.en:
Kiffmeyer left in 1990; Tré Cool fixed the classic three. Jason White later often adds live/rhythm guitar without changing core writing credits.

From Dookie through American Idiot the writing names stay the same three.

Peak citation years are 1994 and 2004.
body.zh:
Kiffmeyer 于 1990 年离队；Tré Cool 固定经典三人。Jason White 后来常加现场/节奏吉他，不改核心写作署名。

从《Dookie》到《American Idiot》，写作名仍是这三人。

巅峰引用年是 1994 与 2004。

body.en:
Blink-182, Fall Out Boy, and 2000s Warped-era acts cite Dookie chorus writing. American Idiot showed concept punk could fill arenas.

On 1994 alt radio they sat beside Nirvana with different gear: Marshall/power chords versus Seattle soft-loud.

What later bands took was melody plus three-chord speed.
body.zh:
Blink-182、Fall Out Boy 与 2000 年代 Warped 期乐队常引用《Dookie》副歌写法。《American Idiot》显示概念朋克可填满 arenas。

1994 alt 电台上与 Nirvana 同代，装备不同：Marshall/power chords 对西雅图 soft-loud。

后来乐队主要沿用的是旋律与三和弦速度。

interviewQuotes.text: Dookie was just our songs played louder. The radio made it a movement.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Billie Joe Armstrong

interviewQuotes.text: American Idiot had to be a story. Punk can hold a concept if the choruses still hit.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Billie Joe Armstrong
